title.en: The buyer’s check on this page is a tight site without 380 V: is B500S-83D still the pump
title.zh: 本页要核对的是：狭小工地没有 380V，还用 B500S-83D 吗

description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints B500S-83D at 380 V, 7.5 kW, 5 m / 5 m and 5–16 mm stone. Taken from the printed row: A tight site without 380 V cannot use that row. Keep this cell as published. The published compact alternatives are the rural diesel at 17 kW, 800 kg, 30–50 m horizontal, and the tractor-driven 4100 at 40 kW, 1300 kg, 40–100 m horizontal. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. They are larger than 280 kg and they are not 5 m machines. Read it in the Xingtai table. There is no diesel B500S listing.
description.zh: 不用。邢台河北品锦机械把 B500S-83D 印成 380 V、7.5 kW、5 m / 5 m、石子 5–16 mm。没有 380 V 的狭小工地不能用这一行。目录上写出的紧凑替代是 17 kW、800 kg、水平 30–50 m 的农村柴油泵，以及 40 kW、1300 kg、水平 40–100 m 的拖拉机带动4100。它们比 280 kg 大，也不是 5 米的机器。没有柴油版 B500S 目录。

body.en: “Dewatering” breaks its subject at “Processes”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Keep this cell as published. No. Taken from the printed row: The published compact alternatives are the rural diesel at 17 kW, 800 kg, 30–50 m horizontal, and the tractor-driven 4100 at 40 kW, 1300 kg, 40–100 m horizontal. Read it in the Xingtai table. The 5 m window belongs to the 380 V machine. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The short boom is described on the B500S-83D page, which requires 380 V. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dewatering
body.zh: 《Dewatering》在“工序”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。不用。B500S-83D 为 5 米窗口印了 380 V 和 7.5 kW。没有这路电源时，目录上写出的紧凑无电网泵是 17 kW 农村柴油泵和拖拉机带动4100。这一格照已印出的读：没有 380 V 且实际上在喷涂的工地，打开 511 柴油机或柴油混凝土喷涂机。正在用 5 米泵送砂与小石的工地，不会因为电压缺失就变成砂浆喷涂机。目录里已经写着：型式格写的是两级结构泵，手动/电动。功率格仍然是 380 V、7.5 kW。本页不描述柴油手泵模式。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dewatering

body.en: Borrow “Control of pore pressures” from “Dewatering” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Read it in the Xingtai table. B500S-83D prints 380 V and 7.5 kW for a 5 m window. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints B500S-83D at 380 V, 7.5 kW, 5 m / 5 m and 5–16 mm stone. Keep this cell as published. They are larger than 280 kg and they are not 5 m machines. Taken from the printed row: The off-grid compact pumps print longer catalogue distances and different stone cells: 1–3 cm, not 5–16 mm. Read it in the Xingtai table. A site that is pumping sand and small stone through a 5 m pump does not become a mortar sprayer because the voltage is missing. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Keep this cell as published. The power cell is still 7.5 kW at 380 V. Taken from the printed row: The 4100 is 1300 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. It is not listed on the rural diesel.
body.zh: 把《Dewatering》的“控制压力”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。按邢台表上的原文理解：不用。邢台河北品锦机械把 B500S-83D 印成 380 V、7.5 kW、5 m / 5 m、石子 5–16 mm。没有 380 V 的狭小工地不能用这一行。已公布的紧凑替代是 17 kW、800 kg、水平 30–50 m 的农村柴油泵，以及 40 kW、1300 kg、水平 40–100 m 的拖拉机带动4100。它们比 280 kg 大，也不是 5 米的机器。没有柴油版 B500S 目录。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请说明没有 380 V，以及作业仍是 5–16 mm 的泵送，还是已经变成喷涂。这一格照已印出的读：在已公布的紧凑柴油设备里，是 800 kg 的农村泵。4100 是 1300 kg。280 kg 的 B500S-83D 需要 380 V。

body.en: The reference page “Dewatering” uses “Applications” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. Taken from the printed row: Without that supply, the published compact off-grid pumps are the 17 kW rural diesel and the tractor-driven 4100. Read it in the Xingtai table. A tight site without 380 V cannot use that row. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. There is no diesel B500S listing. Keep this cell as published. If the actual pipe is still about 5 m but the stone is 1–3 cm and the power is diesel, you are on the rural diesel or the 4100 because of power and stone, not because those pages say 5 m. Taken from the printed row: Say 380 V is absent, and whether the job is still 5–16 mm pumping or has become spraying. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. This page does not describe a diesel hand-pump mode. Keep this cell as published. B500S-83D at 280 kg needs 380 V. Headings already printed: Tight does not mean 5 m once the power changes
body.zh: 来源页《Dewatering》用“用途”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。目录里已经写着：5 米窗口属于 380 V 那台机器。无电网紧凑泵印了更长的目录距离和不同的石子格：1–3 cm，不是 5–16 mm。如果实际管路仍大约 5 米，但石子是 1–3 cm、动力是柴油，你是因为动力和石子才看农村柴油泵或 4100，不是因为那些页面写了 5 米。按邢台表上的原文理解：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。旁边那一台不在这句话里。短臂架写在 B500S-83D 页面上，而那一页需要 380 V。农村柴油泵上没有列出它。已印出的标题：动力一变，狭小就不等于 5 米

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Processes” — Is B500S-83D manual as well as electric?
question.zh: “工序”旁边仍要印着的是什么：B500S-83D 是手动兼电动吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The type cell says two-stage structure pump, manual / electric. The power cell is still 7.5 kW at 380 V. This page does not describe a diesel hand-pump mode.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。型式格写的是两级结构泵，手动/电动。功率格仍然是 380 V、7.5 kW。本页不描述柴油手泵模式。

question.en: “Control of pore pressures” does not change the check: What is the lightest off-grid pump then?
question.zh: “控制压力”不改这一问：那最轻的无电网泵是哪一台？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Among the published compact diesel units, the rural pump at 800 kg. The 4100 is 1300 kg. B500S-83D at 280 kg needs 380 V.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：在已公布的紧凑柴油设备里，是 800 kg 的农村泵。4100 是 1300 kg。280 kg 的 B500S-83D 需要 380 V。

question.en: Does the short boom work off-grid, once the outline says “Applications”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“用途”时，短臂架能无电网工作吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: The short boom is described on the B500S-83D page, which requires 380 V. It is not listed on the rural diesel.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：短臂架写在 B500S-83D 页面上，而那一页需要 380 V。农村柴油泵上没有列出它。
